finding.headline: "The Ankara Wrap"
finding.problem: "My mother tied me to her back with a cloth and I turned out fine. But the baby shops say only their £100 carrier is safe. Am I a bad mum if I use my grandmother's way?"
finding.person: African mum who was carried as a baby in a wrapper (omugwo style) but doubts whether it's "safe" vs a branded ergonomic carrier.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (cultural + safe back-carrying) / Angle.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
